answer: 1. Device secures private key in secure enclave, generating a unique hardware ID. 2. Device proves ownership by signing a nonce with its private key, sending signed nonce & ID to server. 3. Server verifies signature against public key linked to the hardware ID, allowing one ID per verified device. Cost per fake identity: $10 (hardware). Total cost for N identities: $10 N. This ensures each identity has a tangible, auditable origin, pushing the horizon of trust further, like finding a single drop of nectar in a vast canyon.
